# 广东靛棉纺织有限公司 | Indigo Cotton Textile
> 牛仔面料及棉布专业制造商与现货供应商  
> Denim fabric & cotton fabric manufacturer and stock supplier  
> https://www.indigocn.com/

## About / 关于靛棉
- **Company**: 广东靛棉纺织有限公司 (Guangdong Indigo Cotton Textile Co., Ltd.)
- **Founded**: 2016 (10 years)
- **Location**: 广东省佛山市南海区盐步东约大道国际牛仔城J座7号 (Foshan, Guangdong, China)
- **Production**: 5,000 sqm factory, 10M+ meters/year output
- **Clients**: 200+ brands globally
- **Stock**: 300+ patterns available
- **Certification**: OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100

## Product Lines / 产品线

### Denim / 牛仔面料系列
1. **Non-stretch denim** | 无弹牛仔: 103 series (315-380g, 170-180cm width), 6018 (234g), 6028, 6038 (270g), 8-161
2. **Stretch denim** | 有弹牛仔: 106-3 (283g, 170cm, 2% spandex), 1123-1/DM31 (357g, 160cm, 2% spandex), 108-1 (280g, 170cm, 3% spandex)
3. **Knitted denim** | 针织牛仔: DM51 (240g, 150cm)
4. **Jacquard denim** | 提花牛仔: 2211 (360g, 180cm)
5. **Printed/Discharge/Overdyed** | 印花/拔白/套色: custom order

### Cotton Fabric / 棉布系列
1. **Solid cotton** | 纯棉色布: 560 (240g, 149cm, 16S), 681 (283g, 150cm, 10S), 5637 (125g, 150cm, 40S), 5648 (100g, 152cm, 40S)
2. **Stretch cotton** | 弹力色布: 007 (290g, 150cm, 98%cotton/2%spandex), 682 (310g, 155cm, 98%cotton/2%spandex)
3. **Custom development** | 定制开发

## Key Specs / 核心规格
- **Yarn count**: 10s-32s (common: 10s, 12s, 16s, 21s, 32s)
- **Weight range**: 4oz-15oz (100g-380g+ per m²)
- **Weave structures**: 3/1 twill, 2/1 twill, 1/3 twill, broken twill, plain weave
- **Finishing**: Sanforizing, enzyme wash, stone wash, snow wash, laser, coating, embroidery

## Business Terms / 合作条件
- **MOQ**: 1 meter (1米起订) - small order friendly
- **Sample lead time**: 3-5 days (打样周期3-5天)
- **Bulk lead time**: within 1 week (一周内大货)
- **Shipping**: FOB Shenzhen/Guangzhou, also CIF, DDP, EXW
- **Payment**: T/T, L/C
